pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Serverless Framework is a command-line tool for building and deploying applications on AWS Lambda and other managed cloud services, defined by a serverless.yml/serverless.compose.yml configuration file.
This package installs upstream's own prebuilt, versioned distribution archive (the same JavaScript bundle produced by upstream's release pipeline and normally fetched by upstream's "serverless" npm installer stub or install.sh launcher at first run) and runs it directly with the system Node.js interpreter, instead of running either of those upstream installers. No npm install, dependency resolution, or network access happens during any ebuild phase, and nothing in this package downloads or replaces the installed CLI at runtime.
Serverless Framework v4 is proprietary software distributed under the Serverless Customer Agreement, not an open-source license; only a subset of its own dependencies (e.g. @serverless/framework) are separately MIT-licensed. Actually running most commands (beyond --version/--help) requires either a Serverless License Key or authentication against Serverless's SaaS Dashboard, and the Agreement mandates telemetry sharing unless a License Key permits disabling it; this package does not patch, disable, or work around any of that. "Free User" eligibility is defined in Section 1.9 of the Agreement, which also requires the classification to be reassessed monthly rather than checked once. Determining and maintaining eligibility, and completing authentication, are the user's responsibility.
